data.display_address: Dubai Creek Residence Tower 2 South, Dubai Creek Harbour (The Lagoons), Dubai
data.long_description:
Provident Real Estate is delighted to present this elegant one-bedroom apartment in Creek Residences South Tower 2, located in the heart of the iconic Dubai Creek Harbour. Perfectly suited for both end users and investors, this residence offers an exceptional opportunity to own a home in one of Dubai’s most sought-after waterfront communities.

The apartment features a spacious layout, contemporary interiors, and floor-to-ceiling windows that fill the space with natural light while showcasing stunning community and marina views. Residents can enjoy the convenience of nearby shops, cafes, restaurants, parks, and leisure facilities, all within walking distance.

Property Details:

1 Bedroom
2 Bathrooms
Built-up Area: 1,024.83 Sq. Ft.
Currently Rented
High-Quality Finishes & Modern Design

About Dubai Creek Harbour:

Dubai Creek Harbour is a visionary waterfront destination by Emaar, offering a lifestyle that combines luxury, sustainability, and nature-inspired living. Designed to balance urban sophistication with ecological harmony, the community features nine distinctive districts including The Island District and The Sanctuary District.
Residents enjoy access to a world-class yacht club, marina and harbour, 22 hotels, 6.79 million sqm of residential space, and an extensive range of retail and dining experiences—all set against panoramic views of the Dubai skyline.
